criterion: patient ids, recordings, units, coordinates, transforms, channels and annotations coherent and traceable to checksummed raw files; exclusions have reasons
criterion_version: study-001 T0027 frozen acceptance criterion (protocol v1, release rel-823fa0c912cb)
evaluator: R5-independent-evaluation (instance r5-case-qc); independent of R2 producer; R2 QC scripts (work/T0016, T0020, T0023) not used
held_out_data: not_applicable (case-curation check on raw ds004100 v1.1.3 files; no outcomes accessed; participants.tsv and vault not opened)

result.checksums: all 254 files of the 10 cases re-hashed (sha256, every file not just a sample): 254/254 match T0015 retrieval_manifest (sha+bytes) and every PatientCase checksum entry; no files missing or unlisted
result.facts: for all 10 cases R5 recount equals payload: ictal/interictal run counts, per-run sfreq, n_samples, duration, n_channels (own EDF header parser), EDF labels == channels.tsv, soz/resect/bad sets (channels.tsv status/status_description, identical across runs), one 'sz onset'+'sz offset' per ictal run at the stated times with sample==onset*fs, sidecar RecordingDuration = EDF duration - 1 sample
result.coordinate_units: mm confirmed in all 10 cases (declared 'm' wrong): max|coord| 66.8-92.9, nearest-neighbour median 4.7-9.3 (SEEG 4.7-6.3, ECoG 7.6-9.3), consecutive-contact median 4.9-11.1, L/R prefix vs sign of x 100% consistent, 96.8-100% inside MNI box [-80,80]x[-120,90]x[-70,90] (HUP173 RE08/RF08/RG07/RG08 at x 80.6-84.6). Template identity ICBM152 vs fsaverage/MNI305 remains to_verify.

signal_spot_checks.HUP173: trailing pad 0.86/0.96/0.66 s ictal-01/02/05 confirmed (+0.04/0.09 s in 03/04 unreported); line 14.9 dB ictal-01

signal_spot_checks.HUP141: LB01/RB10 top amplitude confirmed; unreported trailing pad in all 5 ictal runs (0.13-0.97 s)

r5_additional_findings: trailing all-channel constant (~0.76 uV = digital zero) EDF pad in 21/61 runs (ictal only, last EDF record, <1 s): R2 reported it only for HUP173 (3 runs), HUP070 (1 run) and HUP105 (as 'transient'); recommend cohort-wide rule: drop last 1 s (last EDF record) of every ictal run

uncertainty_method: deterministic re-computation (exact hash/count/set equality); signal metrics are single-pass point estimates with fixed thresholds (flat std<0.5 uV or >50% zero diffs; robust log-std z>5; 60 Hz band 59-61 vs 50-57/63-70 Hz Welch 2 s; step = >50% channels |diff|>20 robust SD); signal QC spot-checked 1-5 ictal runs per case (19 runs incl. 2 HUP166 interictal), end-pad sweep on all 61 runs
verdict: passed (20/20 artifacts) with documented limits: unreported trailing EDF pads and coincident coordinates noted in gate reasons; none changes an accept_with_limits verdict
evidence_level: independent re-verification against checksummed raw files (observed_measurement); coordinate template identity to_verify
